title: Only precise down to 10 mg
text: Only precise down to 10 mg. I got the scale to precisely measure out some medications for my dog.  Pet med shortages mean I have to break apart capsules and measure lower doses myself.  The scale does not register a 5 mg weight although the display is capable, the scale isn’t sensitive enough. When you first load something on the scale it only starts reading weight when you get to 10 mg. We tried putting additional weight on the scale and then trying to add to see if I could pick up an additional 5 mg and it can’t. So if you don’t need to go below 10 mg you should be fine. But it doesn’t work for measuring below that.
